title: Capivasertib Combination Therapy in Advanced Breast Cancer and Other Solid Tumors: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Efficacy, Safety, and Biomarker-Defined Outcomes.
snippet: Capivasertib is an oral pan-AKT inhibitor evaluated in combination with multiple systemic therapies across solid tumors, but its efficacy and safety vary by disease setting, biomarker status, and treatment backbone.
